deviations: Performance index: used the dataset's provided PCAperf variable (first principal component of GPA, exams passed, eligible to continue) rather than recomputing it; a PC1 recomputed on the 498-student working sample correlates 0.995 with PCAperf but has a different scale (sd ratio 1.18), so it was printed as an unscored robustness line only.
GPA: used the dataset's provided standardized GPA variable (standardized on a sample broader than the 499-student working sample; mean -0.01 in it).
notes: Data: uctdata_balanced.dta (499 students x 2 rounds); kept the follow-up round (round 2), one row per student, with baseline IATs from DscoreraceIATbas/DscoreacaIATbas. Working sample 499 (332 black, 117 white, 18 coloured, 32 Indian/Asian/other). Own controls: Female, UCT admission score (Falseuct2012 + missfalse), wealth index (durpcabas_nomiss + miss dummy), consumption (consbas_nomiss + miss dummy), Foreign, private high school (mean-imputed with missing dummies; all-zero missing dummies dropped). Roommate controls: same minus female, with their missing dummies. Table 3: OLS of follow-up Race IAT on mixracebas + baseline Race IAT + controls, residence FE, by race. Table 4: adds academic program (regprogram) FE; panels A/B residence FE; panel C adds White/Coloured/Indian-Other dummies and race-group (Black/White/residual) x residence FE. SEs clustered by roomnum_base (room ids are unique across residences). fixest::feols. Attempts 1-2 were exploratory (variable listing, panel structure, PCA check), no RESULT lines. The final script was the only scored run; no repairs. No docker hangs. Only the task's mount and paper.txt were read; no script files in the package were opened.
